Let me start with the base stack: docker compose up -d --build. This builds Next.js app which may take a while (large). Let me start the build. Use docker compose up --build -d. It might take more than 600s. Let me run build in background with nohup to avoid timeout, then poll.

Actually the command timeout is 600s. npm ci + next build for a Payload app could exceed that. Better run in background: nohup docker compose up -d --build > build.log 2>&1 & then poll.

Let me do that.
